title: Orbit SaaS — multi-thread
description: Economic buyer joins late. Budget exists but IT wants SSO and audit logs first.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Thanks both — Leah from sales eng and Dev from IT. Let's align on must-haves.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Leah here. We like the receipts feature. Managers finally see why a deal slipped.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Dev speaking. No SSO, no deal. We also need per-call audit logs for ninety days.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: SSO via SAML is on the enterprise path, and every run already stores a status record.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Budget is approved for two quarters if IT signs off. Without that, we freeze.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: I'll schedule a thirty-minute security deep-dive with Dev and share our audit schema.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Next step from us: Dev reviews the schema this week; Leah maps five open opportunities.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Objection remains on unlimited seats messaging — we need clear usage-based pricing.

transcript.speaker: Rep
transcript.text: Usage is minutes on Hear and Recap — no seat math. I'll send a pricing worksheet.

transcript.speaker: Prospect
transcript.text: Intent is to choose a vendor before our board pack locks on the twentieth.

Leah & Dev —

Thanks for the joint session.

Next from us:
1) 30-minute security deep-dive invite for Dev
2) Audit schema (90-day per-call status records)
3) Usage-based pricing worksheet (Hear + Recap minutes — no seat math)

From you (as stated): Dev reviews schema this week; Leah maps five open opportunities.

Goal: vendor choice before board pack locks on the twentieth.

— OpenGong Lite
